about.description: Driven by our concern for Indonesian shrimp farmers facing high operational costs that affect productivity, we are committed to continuously delivering innovative technology solutions.

ourServices.description: From pond development to funding and market access, Crustea provides a range of services to support productivity, efficiency, and sustainability in aquaculture businesses.

profitSharing.title: Profit-Sharing Projects & Pond Development
profitSharing.description: We operate aquaculture projects through profit-sharing models, covering everything from pond construction to technology support and market access to create efficient and sustainable systems.

operationalSupport.title: Consulting & Operational Support
operationalSupport.description: We provide guidance for shrimp and fish farming, from planning to implementation, including on-site and remote technology support focused on water quality, energy efficiency, and disease prevention.

energyManagement.title: Energy Management & Optimization
energyManagement.description: We provide systems to monitor, manage, and optimize energy use through efficient equipment, automation, and renewable energy to help reduce electricity costs without compromising productivity.

sustainability.title: Sustainability & Empowerment
sustainability.description: We support efficient aquaculture trading and create value-added processed shrimp and fish products through women's empowerment, economic inclusion, and waste reduction.

fundingPartners.title: Access to Funding Partners
fundingPartners.description: We provide tailored financial solutions for aquaculture projects, including access to resources for business expansion and operational optimization.

marketAccess.title: Market Access
marketAccess.description: We support the sale of high-quality shrimp, fish, and waste-based products to local markets and global export markets.

featuredProducts.description: Technology solutions designed to help farmers monitor water quality, improve aeration efficiency, and optimize energy use in aquaculture ponds.

ecoAerator.description: Aeration technology powered by solar panels and an impeller, designed to produce smaller bubbles and increase oxygen levels.

smartEnergy.description: A solution that makes it easier to monitor and control aerator energy consumption through mobile devices.

traction.description: Crustea continues to grow through collaboration with farmers, partners, and stakeholders across the aquaculture ecosystem.

ourImpact.description: Our solutions focus not only on productivity, but also on efficiency, the environment, and empowerment across the aquaculture ecosystem.

story.paragraph1: Driven by our concern for Indonesian shrimp farmers who face high operational costs that affect productivity, we are committed to continuously delivering technological innovations as solutions.
story.paragraph2: Through the development of aquaculture technology, Crustea strives to support farmers in sustainably improving pond productivity and operational efficiency.
